verses.text: In Judah is God known: His name is great in Israel.

segments.text: In Judah is God known:
His name is great in Israel.

verses.text: In Salem also is his tabernacle, And his dwelling-place in Zion.

segments.text: In Salem also is his tabernacle,
And his dwelling-place in Zion.

verses.text: There he brake the arrows of the bow; The shield, and the sword, and the battle. [Selah

segments.text: There he brake the arrows of the bow;
The shield, and the sword, and the battle. [Selah

verses.text: Glorious art thou and excellent, From the mountains of prey.

segments.text: Glorious art thou
and
excellent,
From the mountains of prey.

verses.text: The stouthearted are made a spoil, They have slept their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.

segments.text: The stouthearted are made a spoil,
They have slept their sleep;
And none of the men of might have found their hands.

verses.text: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

segments.text: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob,
Both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

verses.text: Thou, even thou, art to be feared; And who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

segments.text: Thou, even thou, art to be feared;
And who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

verses.text: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,

segments.text: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven;
The earth feared, and was still,

verses.text: When God arose to judgment, To save all the meek of the earth. [Selah

segments.text: When God arose to judgment,
To save all the meek of the earth. [Selah

verses.text: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: The residue of wrath shalt thou gird upon thee.

segments.text: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee:
The residue of wrath shalt thou gird upon thee.

verses.text: Vow, and pay unto Jehovah your God: Let all that are round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

segments.text: Vow, and pay unto Jehovah your God:
Let all that are round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

verses.text: He will cut off the spirit of princes: He is terrible to the kings of the earth.

segments.text: He will cut off the spirit of princes:
He is terrible to the kings of the earth.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.
